title: Torsion-free relative normalization stalks over punctured DVR stalks
statement: Let X be locally Noetherian, U an open of X, and p:P -> U a finite etale morphism [def-weil-finite-integral-morphism, def-weil-etale-morphism]. Set a=p composed with U -> X and take x in its concrete relative normalization [lem-weil-pbc-relative-normalization]. Suppose s=a.fromNormalization(x) is outside U and O_{X,s} is a domain and a DVR [def-sc-discrete-valuation-ring]. Then O_{a.normalization,x} is torsion-free as an O_{X,s}-module for the algebra structure induced by a.fromNormalization.stalkMap(x).

source.place: Tags 0307 (integral closure commutes with localization), 035I (relative normalization), 0539 (subsequent torsion-free flatness criterion).

proof.text: Write R=O_{X,s} and K=Frac(R). Base change along Spec R -> X. Apply normalization-stalk-base-change with c the identity of X (the pullback of the identity is Spec R) to identify the relative normalization after this localization with the pullback of a.normalization. The inverse image of U is an open omitting the closed point of Spec R, hence is either empty or Spec K, since a DVR has only its zero and maximal primes.

If that open is empty, the pulled-back cover and its relative normalization are empty, so there is no point above x. Otherwise the pulled-back cover is finite etale over K and is affine with coordinate K-algebra B. The relative normalization over Spec R is Spec C, where C is the integral closure of R in B. The actual inclusion C -> B is injective; multiplication by any nonzero r of R is injective on B since r becomes a unit in K. It is therefore injective on C.

Localization at a source prime is exact, so multiplication by every nonzero r remains injective on C_q. The corresponding point over x exists in the pullback because its image is s; the local ring there identifies with the original source stalk, since base-change to Spec O_{X,s} only inverts elements already units in that source stalk. These canonical affine and stalk identifications preserve the R-action and transport torsion-freeness to the displayed algebra structure. Empty covers are vacuous; disconnected finite etale K-algebras are allowed because only the K-module structure is used.

lean.statement:
theorem punctured_dvr_normalization_stalk_torsionFree
    {X : Scheme.{u}} [IsLocallyNoetherian X] (U : X.Opens)
    {P : Scheme.{u}} (p : P ⟶ U.toScheme) [IsFinite p] (hetale : Etale p)
    (x : (p ≫ U.ι).normalization)
    (hs : (p ≫ U.ι).fromNormalization x ∉ U)
    [IsDomain (X.presheaf.stalk ((p ≫ U.ι).fromNormalization x))]
    [IsDiscreteValuationRing (X.presheaf.stalk ((p ≫ U.ι).fromNormalization x))] :
    letI := ((p ≫ U.ι).fromNormalization.stalkMap x).hom.toAlgebra
    Module.IsTorsionFree (X.presheaf.stalk ((p ≫ U.ι).fromNormalization x))
      ((p ≫ U.ι).normalization.presheaf.stalk x)
